parameters.content:
**AHAWR Status Bot — control bot**

Long-polls Telegram every 60 s (getUpdates timeout 25 s as a request parameter, HTTP client timeout 30 s, ~1440 executions/day) and handles both messages and callback_query. Runs cannot overlap: a static-data run flag (poll_in_progress) is set before each getUpdates and cleared after it; a trigger that finds the flag set skips the run. Only chats in `hermes_config.telegram_chat_id` are answered; others are counted silently. Mutating commands (control and edit) require a confirmation (inline button or one-time code, 2-min TTL) before any change is applied and are written to the audit table; every callback_query is acknowledged with answerCallbackQuery. The bot cannot launch runs itself: confirmed /start, /resume and /restart insert a row into the AHAWR Command Queue table and the reply states the operator launch line (the operator executes it); confirmed /retry and /accept set the Live State flags the main workflow consumes during a running mission. The bot token lives in the `telegramApi` credential, never in the workflow file.
